query: Please implement a web application that supports multiple payment methods, allowing users to choose from different payment options. The application should have functionalities for adding, editing, and deleting payment methods, as well as handling payment success and failure logic. Users should be able to view payment history and balance information. Set page background to floral white; color all components with dark red.
